excerpts.label: Early window
excerpts.quote: With the catastrophe in which the wars of the French Revolution terminated, and our own subsequent peace with Great Britain, this baneful weed of party strife was uprooted.

excerpts.quote: But it can be a peace - and it will be a peace - based on the sound and just principles of the Atlantic Charter - on the concept of the dignity of the human being - and on the guarantees of tolerance and freedom of religious worship.

excerpts.cite: Franklin D. Roosevelt, Address to Congress on Yalta, 1945

fine_topics.name: Cold War & Great-Power Rivalry
fine_topics.definition: The global contest with Soviet and Chinese communism and later confrontation and negotiation with great-power rivals and rogue regimes over security and influence.

fine_topics.name: Nuclear Weapons & Arms Control
fine_topics.definition: The danger of nuclear war and fallout, superpower vulnerability, and efforts to limit or reduce nuclear arms through negotiation and treaties.

fine_topics.name: Iraq, Gulf Wars, the War on Terror & Interventions
fine_topics.definition: Confronting Iraqi aggression and terrorism, combating al Qaeda and weapons of mass destruction, and armed interventions and peacekeeping in trouble spots.

fine_topics.name: Military Preparedness, Armed Forces & Veterans
fine_topics.definition: Organizing and equipping the militia, army, and navy, fortifications and armament, readiness in peacetime, and the care and honoring of veterans and service members.

fine_topics.name: World Order, Foreign Aid & Democracy Promotion
fine_topics.definition: The United Nations and international order, economic assistance to developing nations, and the conviction that America should spread liberty and democracy abroad.

fine_topics.name: Treaties, Diplomacy & International Arbitration
fine_topics.definition: General conduct of foreign intercourse through treaties, conventions, boundary commissions, recognition of new states, and peaceful settlement of disputes by arbitration.

fine_topics.name: Immigration & Border Security
fine_topics.definition: Welcoming or restricting immigrants, border walls and enforcement, deportation and detention, and framing immigration as a security concern.
